name: jina_ai
description: Embeddings, reranking, document OCR and batch embedding jobs for search and RAG
long_description: Bring a Jina AI API key; the gateway keeps it off your Sprite and sends it as a bearer token. Saving, replacing or testing the key embeds one short word with jina-embeddings-v5-text-nano (POST /v1/embeddings), which uses a few tokens from the key's balance. A Sprite can then create text and multimodal embeddings, rerank documents against a query, transcribe document images with jina-ocr-v1, submit batch embedding jobs and read their status, output and errors, and read the model catalogue. Every embedding, rerank, OCR and batch request uses tokens from your Jina AI balance. Jina's Reader (r.jina.ai), Search (s.jina.ai) and other hosts, batch job cancellation, and API key, balance and billing management are not forwarded.

messages.400: Jina AI rejected the request (%{status}); check the body's detail and code
messages.403: Jina AI refused the request: the key's token balance is exhausted or the plan limit was reached; top up at jina.ai/api-dashboard
messages.404: Jina AI could not find that batch job or model
messages.409: Jina AI batch job is being modified; retry shortly
messages.422: Jina AI could not validate the request body; see errors for the field
messages.429: Jina AI rate limit reached (requests, tokens or concurrency per minute); try again later
messages.504: Jina AI timed out processing the request; send smaller inputs or use a batch job
messages.provider_unreachable: Could not reach Jina AI; retry later

presentation.tagline: Embed, rerank and OCR documents with Jina AI from a Sprite without putting your key on it.
presentation.setup: Open jina.ai/api-dashboard/key-manager, sign in and create an API key (it starts with `jina_`). New keys come with free trial tokens; top up on the same dashboard.

notices.title: Billing
notices.body: Saving or testing the key sends one embedding request for a single word with `jina-embeddings-v5-text-nano`, which uses a few tokens from the key's balance: Jina counts its task prefix and special tokens as well as the word (that model is listed at $0.00000002 per token). Embeddings, rerank and batch jobs are charged per input token; OCR with `jina-ocr-v1` is charged for input and output tokens, and an A4 page is about 900 input tokens. `GET /v1/models` lists each model's per-token price and is free. Responses report what was used in `usage.total_tokens`. If auto top-up is turned on for the key, Jina charges your saved payment method when the balance runs low.

notices.title: Scope
notices.body: Only `POST /v1/embeddings`, `POST /v1/rerank`, `POST /v1/chat/completions` (document OCR), `POST /v1/batch/embeddings`, `GET /v1/batches`, `GET /v1/batch/:batch_id`, `GET /v1/batch/:batch_id/output`, `GET /v1/batch/:batch_id/errors`, `GET /v1/models`, `GET /v1/models/:model_id` and `GET /v1/models/jina-ai/:model_id` on `api.jina.ai` are forwarded. A batch job can name a `webhook_url` that Jina sends a POST to when the job completes, and an `input_url` that Jina fetches the input file from. Cancelling batch jobs, API key and balance management, and Jina's Reader (`r.jina.ai`) and Search (`s.jina.ai`) APIs are not forwarded.

usage_notes: Sprites waits 120 seconds for Jina AI's response headers, and Jina's API has no timeout parameter. Keep inline embedding, rerank and OCR requests small (one PDF or page image at a time) and send large workloads as a batch job.

Errors are usually `{"detail": "...", "code": "...", "request_id": "..."}`, with `errors` listing fields on a 422. Reading a model that does not exist (`GET /v1/models/...`) answers 404 with `detail` as an object holding `message`, `code` and `request_id`, so do not assume `detail` is a string. `/v1/chat/completions` answers 400, 404, 409 and 5xx in OpenAI's `{"error": {...}}` envelope instead. A 403 with `AUTHZ_INSUFFICIENT_BALANCE` means the key is valid but out of tokens.
Rate limits apply per key in requests and tokens per minute; read the current limits at jina.ai/api-dashboard/rate-limit.
